en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a two‑storey wooden commercial building with steep tiled roofs and ornate, Nordic-style carved woodwork around the central entrance. Large display windows with awnings suggest a shop. Two people stand in front of the building. In the upper left corner, printed text reads "Løitens Handelsforening." The surroundings appear rural with additional wooden buildings in the background.
